done.why: I beat the hooded figure but found no way past the barriers: rockfalls, a squeeze, surf, quicksand and the lake. I then lost my lamp and sword in the lake and had nothing left to try.

about: A small cave region at the end of a longer adventure. A dream-voice says to seek him when worthy. There are shadowy hills, a sea, a lake and an aqueduct, plus a duel with a hooded figure who mirrors you.

moments.note: The sword appeared in my hand when the hooded figure showed up.
The duel is long and swingy. 'Feeble attack' appears when I don't say 'with sword'.
The Land of Shadow rooms are hard to map, with repeated names.
The figure dies with a glimpse of sorrowful eyes.
Entering the lake dropped my lamp and sword with no warning, and the lake had no way across.

wished: A clue about where to go after the duel
A warning before the lake took my items
A clearer map of the Land of Shadow

lines.line: You walk west toward the vegetation, and the mist comes down over it thicker with every step, until you cannot see the ground you are walking on and have to turn back to find it.
The hooded figure, fatally wounded, slumps to the ground. It gazes up at you once, and you catch a brief glimpse of deep and sorrowful eyes.
lines.why: The emotional peak of the game.

fun.why: The duel was tense, but I got stuck afterward.

engagement.why: I had a clear goal at first, then the way forward ran out.

difficulty.why: Many blocked exits and no sign of the next step.

interestingness.why: The mirror-duelist and the aqueduct description give it atmosphere.
